decision.reference: Owner in chat 2026-10-30: pause auto-publishing until the site moves off catchdates.com
decision.summary: Every imported event waits for staff until the rebrand moves the website to its new domain. The 2026-10-25 auto-publish policy (CAT-213) returns as mode auto_publish_approved_organizers after the cutover. Staff can still publish what is waiting and withdraw anything published.
